description: Interactive Brokers PAPER connector. ViceKrack talks to IB Gateway (or TWS) running on this PC, logged in to your PAPER account, using ib_async. Paper ports only: 4002 (IB Gateway paper) or 7497 (TWS paper); the live ports 4001/7496 are always refused, and every account IBKR reports must be a paper account (starts with DU). No API keys are stored: your IBKR login stays inside IBKR's program. client_id 2 is the trading loop's connection (the tutorial uses 2 for the bot and 3 for order placement). Kill switch on = no new orders (checks and cancels still work).
